description: When deduplication is turned off, the backend is notified on every occurrence of an identifier, not just the first. Two triggers of the same identifier produce two notifications and a counter of two.

cases.expected_output:
event=deprecation_notice
backend=trigger_error
message=this is deprecated foo 2222
package=acme/orm
link=https://dep.example.com/orm/2222
event=deprecation_notice
backend=trigger_error
message=this is deprecated foo 2222
package=acme/orm
link=https://dep.example.com/orm/2222
unique_count=2
count[https://dep.example.com/orm/2222]=2
